summary_en: Kamgras 1 raised its tender offer price for Kakaku.com from 3,680 yen to 3,681 yen per share, extending the offer period to October 14, 2026, for a total of 105 business days.
title_en: Notice Regarding Change in Terms and Conditions of Tender Offer for Common Shares and Subscription Rights of Kakaku.com, Inc. (Securities Code: 2371) by Kamgras 1, Inc.
translation_en_brief: Kamgras 1, Inc. announced on September 29, 2026, that it increased the tender offer price for Kakaku.com, Inc. from 3,680 yen to 3,681 yen per share. The tender offer, which began on May 13, 2026, was extended to October 14, 2026, totaling 105 business days. This modest price increase followed a prior adjustment to 3,680 yen on September 10, 2026. Kamgras 1 stated that the price increase was made to enhance the likelihood of the tender offer succeeding, taking into account market movements, shareholder subscription trends, and a statement by Oasis opposing any tender offer below 3,640 yen per share. The bidder noted that the previous price of 3,571 yen from August 27, 2026, already exceeded the maximum executable price of 3,520 yen under the July 29 proposal unless Oasis agreed not to oppose the offer—a prerequisite that Kamgras 1 itself had secured through an agreement with Oasis. The incremental price adjustment appears designed to facilitate Oasis's support for the tender offer while maintaining the transaction's viability.
